DAMGHANI:v1p180/r6.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p180/r6.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p180/r6.claim: Dhikr can mean admonition or exhortation; the cited commands mean to admonish people with the Qur’an.
DAMGHANI:v1p180/r6.anchor: السادس : الذكر بمعنى العظة قوله تعالى في سورة الأنعام

BURSEVI:v10p323#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p323#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p323#2/r1.claim: The Prophet is only a messenger and reminder; guidance and success belong to God.
BURSEVI:v10p323#2/r1.anchor: أي مبلغ وإنما الهداية والتوفيق إلى الله تعالى

QASHANI:88:17/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:88:17/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:88:17/r2.claim: Reminding may benefit someone prepared to ascend toward God; whoever turns away and is veiled by effects from their cause faces the great fire, defined as punishment for absolute veiling across all levels of existence.
QASHANI:88:17/r2.anchor: عسى أن يكون فيهم مستعد يتذكر ويتعظ فيرتقي في السلم المنخلعة إلى جناب الحق لا من أعرض واحتجب بهذه الآثار

QASHANI:88:17/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:88:17/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:88:17/r3.claim: The clause that the Messenger is only a reminder and not a controller is an interruption: his duty is to remind, not overpower or compel, as the cited verses also say.
QASHANI:88:17/r3.anchor: اعتراض أي: ما إليك إلا التذكير لا الغلبة والقهر

QUSHAYRI:v3p416/r22.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p416/r22.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p416/r22.claim: Muhammad is commanded to remind people; he is not their controller, and reminding them is the mission entrusted to him.
QUSHAYRI:v3p416/r22.anchor: أنت مذكر لست عليهم بمصيطر } . لست عليهم بمسلط ؛ فذكر - يا محمد - بما أمرناك

SULAMI:v2p393/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p393/r1.speaker: أبو العباس بن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p393/r1.claim: Admonition serves ordinary people, counsel serves brethren, and reminder serves the elect; reminding discerning believers is obligatory, or the Sunnah and obligations would lapse.
SULAMI:v2p393/r1.anchor: سمعت أبا العباس بن عطاء يقول : الموعظة للعوام ، والنصيحة للإخوان ، والتذكرة للخواص

SULAMI:v2p393/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p393/r2.speaker: الجنيد
SULAMI:v2p393/r2.claim: A true preacher's luminous counsel addresses each listener according to capacity; the Prophet is the model, and real preaching must be authorized before it can counsel.
SULAMI:v2p393/r2.anchor: قال الجنيد رحمه الله : الواعظ على الحقيقة من تكون موعظته على حد الإشراق

IBNASHUR:88:21/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:88:21/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:88:21/r1.claim: The fa branches from the surah's account of the Resurrection and their rejection into an order to keep reminding them, despite their refusal to listen.
IBNASHUR:88:21/r1.anchor: رتب على ذلك أمر الله رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالدوام على تذكيرهم

IBNASHUR:88:21/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:88:21/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:88:21/r2.claim: The continuing command reassures the Prophet that he bears no blame when they fail to listen; he was not sent to compel belief.
IBNASHUR:88:21/r2.anchor: وتثبيته بأنه لا تبعة عليه من عدم إصغائهم إذ لم يُبعث مُلجئاً لهم على الإِيمان

IBNASHUR:88:21/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:88:21/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:88:21/r3.claim: The object of “remind” is omitted and supplied by the later phrase that he is not their controller; the imperative asks for continued effort.
IBNASHUR:88:21/r3.anchor: بالدوام على تذكيرهم وأنه لا يؤيسه إصرارهم على الإعراض

IBNASHUR:88:21/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR:88:21/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR:88:21/r4.claim: Innamā gives an additional restriction: the Messenger's role is reminder, not an agent responsible for producing their recollection, so their failure does not make him negligent.
IBNASHUR:88:21/r4.anchor: لست وكيلاً على تحصيل تذكرهم فلا تتحرج من عدم تذكرهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r1.claim: The imperative calls for continuing and persisting in reminder; its omitted object is supplied by the following statement that the Prophet is no controller over them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r1.anchor: فالأمر مستعمل في طلب الاستمرار والدوام . ومفعول ( ذكر ) محذوف هو ضمير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r2.claim: Innamā gives the reason for continuing despite inattention; its restriction reassures the Prophet that he must remind but is not responsible for producing their acceptance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p306/r2.anchor: والقصر المستفاد ب { إنما } قصر إضافي ، أي أنت مذكر لست وكيلا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p475/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p475/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p475/r7.claim: God commands the Prophet to remind people with this verse and similar signs.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p475/r7.anchor: ثم أمر تعالى نبيه بالتذكير بهذه الآية ونحوها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p100#4/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p100#4/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p100#4/r1.claim: The command is to preach and admonish; at that time the Prophet was commanded only to remind.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p100#4/r1.anchor: فذكر أي عظ إنما أنت مذكر أي واعظ ولم يكن حينئذ أمر بغير التذكير

JISHUMI:v10p7389/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7389/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7389/r7.claim: Another construction connects the exception to “remind”: admonish your people except those who turn away and will not benefit from the reminder.
JISHUMI:v10p7389/r7.anchor: هو راجع إلى قوله: (فذكر) قومك إلا من تولى وأعرض

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p746/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p746/r10.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p746/r10.claim: The Prophet's duty is to remind, as in the declaration that he is responsible only for conveying the message.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p262/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p262/r8.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p262/r8.claim: Another interpretation is to remind them of blessings so they fear punishments.

MUQATIL:88:10-26/r12.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:88:10-26/r12.speaker: author
MUQATIL:88:10-26/r12.claim: Muhammad is to warn Mecca's people, like earlier prophets, and has no authority as a king over them.
MUQATIL:88:10-26/r12.anchor: أهل مكة يا محمد { إنمآ أنت مذكر }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p335#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p335#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p335#4/r1.claim: The Prophet is to remind people of the evidence so that they reflect; his duty is only to convey the message.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p335#4/r1.anchor: ﴿ فذكر ﴾ فذكرهم بالادلة ليتفكروا فيها ﴿ إنما أنت مذكر ﴾

QURTUBI-FULL:88:21-25/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:88:21-25/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:88:21-25/r1.claim: The Prophet is to admonish and warn people; his role is that of a reminder.
QURTUBI-FULL:88:21-25/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { فذكر } أي فعظهم يا محمد وخوفهم. { إنما أنت مذكر } أي واعظ

NAHHAS:v5p213/r15.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p213/r15.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p213/r15.claim: The object of remind is omitted because the hearer knows it: remind God's servants of His proofs and signs; the Prophet's task is only reminder.
NAHHAS:v5p213/r15.anchor: وحذفت المفعول لعلم السامع أي فذكر عبادي حججي وآياتي ( إنما أنت مذكر ) أي ليس عليك إلا التذكير

QUTB-ZILAL:88:21/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:88:21/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet's defined task is to remind people of the afterlife and the signs in creation; his duty goes no further than reminder and delivery.
QUTB-ZILAL:88:21/r1.anchor: ليس لك ولا عليك شيء وراءه

RAZI-FULL:v31p145/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p145/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p145/r1.claim: After proving divine oneness and resurrection, God commands reminder through such proofs, reflection on them, and warning against neglect; the Messenger must also endure obstacles and is commissioned for this task.
RAZI-FULL:v31p145/r1.anchor: وتذكير الرسول إنما يكون بذكر هذه الأدلة وأمثالها والبعث على النظر فيها

STUDYQURAN:88:21/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:88:21/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet's role is to remind; he is not responsible for others' faith or disbelief and cannot create faith in their hearts.
STUDYQURAN:88:21/r1.anchor: The Prophet’s mission is only to remind people of the truth. He will not be held responsible for the faith or disbelief of others

TAB:88:21/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:88:21/r1.speaker: author
TAB:88:21/r1.claim: Muhammad is to remind God's servants with His signs, instruct them with His proofs, deliver the message, recall God's favors, teach their duties, and admonish them.
TAB:88:21/r1.anchor: فَذَكّرْ يا محمد عبادي بآياتي ،   وعظهم بحججي ،   وبلّغهم رسالتي إنّمَا أنْتَ مُذَكّرٌ

TAB-FULL:v24p340#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p340#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p340#2/r1.claim: Muhammad was sent to remind people of God’s favors and their obligations, and to admonish them.
TAB-FULL:v24p340#2/r1.anchor: يقول: إنما أرسلتك إليهم مذكرا، لتذكرهم نعمتي عندهم، وتعرفهم اللازم لهم، وتعظهم

TABATABAI:88:2/r17.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:88:2/r17.speaker: author
TABATABAI:88:2/r17.claim: The command to remind follows because God alone is their Lord and judgment awaits believers and unbelievers; the Messenger’s role is to remind without coercing them.
TABATABAI:88:2/r17.anchor: وظيفته - وهو رسول - التذكرة رجاء أن يستجيبوا ويؤمنوا من غير إكراه وإلجاء

TABATABAI:88:22-26#2/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:88:22-26#2/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
TABATABAI:88:22-26#2/r4.claim: Jābir reports the Prophet’s statement that people’s lives and property are protected once they profess monotheism, except for its due, while their account is with God; the Prophet then recites the reminder verses.
TABATABAI:88:22-26#2/r4.anchor: أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا لا إله إلا الله فإذا قالوها عصموا مني دماءهم

ZAJJAJ:v5p318/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p318/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p318/r8.claim: The command to remind came before the Prophet was ordered to fight.
ZAJJAJ:v5p318/r8.anchor: هذا قبل أن يؤمر النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - بالحرب.

TABRISI:88:20-26/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:88:20-26/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:88:20-26/r2.claim: Reminder explains what people need and makes it understood; the Prophet reminds them of God's favors and their duty of gratitude and worship.
TABRISI:88:20-26/r2.anchor: والتذكير التعريف للذكر بالبيان الذي يقع به الفهم والنفع بالتذكير عظيم

TABRISI:88:20-26/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:88:20-26/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:88:20-26/r3.claim: The explicit reminder command makes religious proofs so clear that blind imitation is inadequate; the source connects it with 51:55 and 16:67.
TABRISI:88:20-26/r3.anchor: وقد أوضح الله تعالى طريق الحجج في الدين وأكده غاية التأكيد بما لا يسع فيه التقليد

TABRISI:88:20-26/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:88:20-26/r4.speaker: الجبائي، أبو مسلم
TABRISI:88:20-26/r4.claim: Al-Jubbāʾī and Abū Muslim say the Prophet should remind people of these proofs and urge them to reason from them.
TABRISI:88:20-26/r4.anchor: إن المراد فذكرهم بهذه الأدلة وأمرهم بالاستدلال بها ونبههم عليها

THALABI:v10p190#2/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p190#2/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p190#2/r1.claim: The Prophet is commanded to remind people, not to coerce their belief; the text says this ruling was then abrogated by the fighting verse.
THALABI:v10p190#2/r1.anchor: بمسلط جبار يكرههم على الإيمان، ثم نسخ ذلك بآية القتال

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p475/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p475/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p475/r1.claim: Muhammad is to admonish as a preacher; at that time his role was only to remind.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p475/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: فعظ إنما أنت واعظ (¬11) (¬12)، ولم يؤمر إذ

WAHIDI-QT:88:21/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:88:21/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet is to remind people of God's blessings and proofs of His oneness, since he was sent for this task.
WAHIDI-QT:88:21/r1.anchor: { فذكر إنما أنت مذكر } ذكرهم نعم الله ودلائل توحيده فانك مبعوث بذلك

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:88:21-26/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:88:21-26/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:88:21-26/r2.claim: The Messenger is to remind people of God's blessings and proofs of His oneness; this is his mission.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:88:21-26/r2.anchor: ذكرهم نعم الله ودلائل توحيده، فإنك مبعوث بذلك.

ELMALILI:88:17/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:88:17/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:88:17/r2.claim: The reminder completes the earlier surah’s call to purification: creation’s signs are studied to infer divine ways and commands and to prompt useful deeds before the closing command to remind.
ELMALILI:88:17/r2.anchor: suhuf-i ûlâda olduğu anlatılan tezekkî mazmûnunun suhuf-i uhrâda mütemmim ve mükemmili

ELMALILI:88:18-26/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r14.claim: The prefixed fā draws the consequence: if they still do not look and think, the Prophet should remind them through preaching and warning and convey the need and results of reflection.
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r14.anchor: O hâlde tezkir et yani hâlâ bakmıyorlar, bunlara nazar edip düşünmüyorlarsa sen onlara va‘z u nasihat ile hatırlat

ELMALILI:88:18-26/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r15.claim: The Prophet’s task is only to deliver and remind; he should not try to force people to think or compel them to believe.
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r15.anchor: tezkir ile iktifâ et de daha ziyade zorlama, zorla düşündüreceğim diye uğraşma

ELMALILI:88:18-26/r21.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r21.speaker: author
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r21.claim: The next surah elaborates the lesson of these reflections by drawing attention to changes in time while explaining the final return to God.
ELMALILI:88:18-26/r21.anchor: Allah’a rücû‘âkıbetinin bir tavzîhi siyâkında zaman tehavvülâtına dikkati celb ile başlayan

CORPUSCORANICUM:88:23:anmerkung/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:23:anmerkung/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:23:anmerkung/r1.claim: The usual reading of ʾillā cannot mean Muhammad has power only over unbelievers, since verses 21–22 say he cannot compel his hearers to believe.
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:23:anmerkung/r1.anchor: Der Vers kann nicht, wie es das gängige Verständnis von ʾillā nahelegt, bedeuten, dass Muḥammad über niemanden außer über die Ungläubigen Gewalt hat

CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r1.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r1.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r1.claim: The closing section directly addresses the Messenger: his role is to warn, and he has no coercive power over his hearers.
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r1.anchor: Das Schlussgesätz beginnt mit einer direkten Anrede des Verkünders: Seine Aufgabe bestehe lediglich darin „zu mahnen“, ansonsten habe er keine Gewalt über seine Hörer

CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r2.author: Nicolai Sinai (Frühmekkanische Suren), with Nora K. Schmid, using preparatory work by Angelika Neuwirth; later parts Dirk Hartwig, Angelika Neuwirth et al. (author line per sura in segments)
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r2.speaker: author
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r2.claim: Earlier direct addresses to the Prophet occur only in short consolations at 93, 94, and 108; in group II, this address becomes integrated into broader literary contexts and a regular sura-ending feature.
CORPUSCORANICUM:88:21-26:kommentar/r2.anchor: Ähnliche Anreden an den Propheten enthalten zuvor nur die kurzen Trostworte Q 93, 94 und 108; in Q 88 und anderen Texten aus Gruppe II wird die Form der Prophetenanrede dann in übergreifende literarische Zusammenhänge integriert

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet must warn and convey revelation without coercion because faith and worship require inward conviction; other verses similarly limit his mission to conveying the message, not ensuring guidance (3:20; 16:82; 28:56; 42:48).
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r1.anchor: Allah Teâlâ resulüne, hiçbir baskı ve zorlamaya meydan vermeden insanları uyarmasını ve gerçekleri onlara yalnızca tebliğ etmesini emretmektedir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r2.speaker: Bazı müfessirler
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r2.claim: Some exegetes say the no-coercion directive was abrogated; the author rejects this, arguing that even after fighting was allowed the Prophet did not force belief, while punitive action addressed harmful agitators.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:88:21/r2.anchor: Bazı müfessirler bu âyetin neshedildiğini yani hükmünün kaldırıldığını söylemişlerse de bize göre bu görüş isabetli değildir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p285/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p285/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p285/r2.claim: Although the address could be general, internal evidence identifies the Prophet as its addressee, confirmed by the sūrah's closing command to remind.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p285/r2.anchor: the address in the verse can also be considered as general

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p465/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p465/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p465/r4.claim: The command to remind means the Prophet should not be troubled by their refusal to look; his task is reminder, as in the declaration that his duty is only conveyance.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p465/r4.anchor: ولما حضهم على النظر، أمر رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم بتذكيرهم فقال: فذكر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r1.claim: The command to remind follows from the rebuke of their failure to reflect: confine yourself to reminding, do not press or be distressed when they do not consider or remember.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r1.anchor: والفاء في قوله تعالى فذكر لترتيب الأمر بالتذكير على ما ينبيء عنه الإنكار السابق من عدم النظر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r2.claim: “You are only a reminder” explains the command.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p117#4/r2.anchor: وقوله تعالى إنما أنت مذكر تعليل للأمر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p411/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p411/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p411/r1.claim: The Prophet is to remind people, not exercise control by killing them or forcing them to believe; al-Baghawi says the fighting verse abrogated this rule.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p411/r1.anchor: [أي: عظ يا محمد] (1) {إنما أنت مذكر لست عليهم بمسيطر}

BAYDAWI-FULL:88:18-21/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:18-21/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:18-21/r5.claim: The Prophet's responsibility is to deliver the reminder; he is not accountable if people fail to reflect or heed it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:18-21/r5.anchor: فلا عليك إن لم ينظروا ولم يذكروا إذ ما عليك إلا البلاغ

BAYDAWI-FULL:88:22-26/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:22-26/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:22-26/r8.claim: A report promises an easy reckoning to whoever recites al-Ghāshiya.
BAYDAWI-FULL:88:22-26/r8.anchor: من قرأ سورة الغاشية حاسبه الله حسابا يسيرا

BIQAI-FULL:v8p404#2/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p404#2/r4.speaker: أبو جعفر بن الزبير
BIQAI-FULL:v8p404#2/r4.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr explains the coherence: after divine transcendence, the question magnifies Resurrection; the passage gives the damned's ordeal, contrasts the blessed, adduces created signs, and commands reminder when signs failed to persuade.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p404#2/r4.anchor: أبو جعفر بن الزبير : لما تقدم تنزيهه سبحانه عما توهم الظالمون

BIQAI-FULL:v8p410#2/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p410#2/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p410#2/r6.claim: The Prophet should remind anyone likely to benefit, awakening innate knowledge in creation so people recognize the Creator's power and the resurrection; their failure to reflect should not trouble him.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p410#2/r6.anchor: كل من يرجى تذكره وانتفاعه بالتذكير يا أشرف خخلقنا

DURR:88:21/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:88:21/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet says he was commanded to fight people until they profess that there is no god but God; then their blood and property are protected except by due right, while their account belongs to God, and he recites this passage.
DURR:88:21/r1.anchor: عن جابر قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : «أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا لا إله إلا الله

DURR-FULL:v8p495/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p495/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p495/r2.claim: Jābir reports that the Prophet said he was ordered to fight people until they profess the oneness of God, after which their blood and property are protected except by right, and their reckoning is with God.
DURR-FULL:v8p495/r2.anchor: عن جابر قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا لا إله إلا الله

ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r1.claim: After urging reflection, God commands the Messenger to remind them and not be troubled if they do not reflect.
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r1.anchor: ولما حضهم على النظر ،   أمر رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم بتذكيرهم

ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r2.claim: The Messenger's role is only to remind, as in the statement that he is responsible only for conveying the message.
ABUHAYYAN:88:21/r2.anchor: { إنما أنت مذكر } ،   كقوله تعالى : { إن عليك إلا البلاغ }

ALUSI:88:21/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI:88:21/r1.claim: The fāʾ makes the command follow the preceding rebuke for failing to reflect: the Prophet should limit himself to reminding, not press them or be distressed by refusal.
ALUSI:88:21/r1.anchor: لترتيب الأمر بالتذكير على ما ينبئ عنه الإنكار السابق من عدم النظر أي فاقتصر

ALUSI:88:21/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI:88:21/r2.claim: You are only a reminder gives the reason for the command.
ALUSI:88:21/r2.anchor: وقوله تعالى : { إنما أنت مذكر } تعليل للأمر

BAYDAWI:88:21/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet's duty is only to convey; he is not blameworthy if people do not consider or remember.
BAYDAWI:88:21/r1.anchor: فذكر إنما أنت مذكر فلا عليك إن لم ينظروا ولم يذكروا إذ ما عليك إلا البلاغ

BIQAI:88:21/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI:88:21/r1.claim: The wonders of creation prove God's complete power, including resurrection and all promised events in Paradise and Hell, so people should contemplate them and follow the messenger.
BIQAI:88:21/r1.anchor: على البعث وعلى كل ما ذكر أنه يفعله في الجنة والنار

BIQAI:88:21/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI:88:21/r2.claim: Remind everyone who might benefit by appealing to innate knowledge that creation confirms revelation and divine power; do not be distressed when people fail to reflect, since reminding may awaken them.
BIQAI:88:21/r2.anchor: كل من يرجى تذكره وانتفاعه بالتذكير يا أشرف خلقنا

BIQAI:88:21/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:88:21/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI:88:21/r3.claim: Biqāʿī offers inward correspondences: obedient camels resemble tranquil souls, the sky luminous spirits, mountains stable intellects and knowledge, and earth the body with its organs.
BIQAI:88:21/r3.anchor: أن الإبل تشبه الأنفس المطمئنة الذلولة المطيعة المناقدة ، والسماء تشبه الأرواح القدسية النورانية ، والجبال تشبه العقول والمعارف الثابتة الراسخة

BIQAI:88:21/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI:88:21/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI:88:21/r4.claim: Because this is an early Meccan sūra when the Prophet was commanded to forbear, he is a reminder, not a fighter or coercive enforcer; he is responsible only for conveying the message.
BIQAI:88:21/r4.anchor: فلا عليك إن لم ينظروا ولم يتذكروا لأنه ما عليك إلا البلاغ

IBNATIYYA:88:21/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA:88:21/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA:88:21/r1.claim: God commands the Prophet to remind people with this verse and similar reminders.
IBNATIYYA:88:21/r1.anchor: ثم أمر تعالى نبيه بالتذكير بهذه الآية ونحوها

IBNKATHIR:88:21/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r1.claim: Muhammad is to remind people of what he was sent with; his duty is to convey, while God will reckon with them.
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r1.anchor: يا محمد - الناس بما أرسلت به إليهم ، فإنما عليك البلاغ وعلينا الحساب

IBNKATHIR:88:21/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r4.speaker: جابر عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r4.claim: The Prophet says he was commanded to fight people until they profess God’s oneness; then their lives and property are protected except by due right, and their reckoning is with God. Ahmad, Muslim, Tirmidhi, and Nasa’i transmit this with the verse recitation; Bukhari and Muslim report it from Abu Hurayra without the verse.
IBNKATHIR:88:21/r4.anchor: عن جابر قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم :  " أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا : لا إله إلا الله

IBNKATHIR:88:22/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r1.claim: Muhammad is to remind people of what he was sent with; his duty is to convey, while God will reckon with them.
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r1.anchor: يا محمد - الناس بما أرسلت به إليهم ، فإنما عليك البلاغ وعلينا الحساب

IBNKATHIR:88:22/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r4.speaker: جابر عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r4.claim: The Prophet says he was commanded to fight people until they profess God’s oneness; then their lives and property are protected except by due right, and their reckoning is with God. Ahmad, Muslim, Tirmidhi, and Nasa’i transmit this with the verse recitation; Bukhari and Muslim report it from Abu Hurayra without the verse.
IBNKATHIR:88:22/r4.anchor: عن جابر قال : قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم :  " أمرت أن أقاتل الناس حتى يقولوا : لا إله إلا الله

KASHSHAF:88:21/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:88:21/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:88:21/r1.claim: Since they do not reflect, the Prophet should remind them without pressing or grieving over their failure to see and remember; his duty is only to deliver the message (42:48).
KASHSHAF:88:21/r1.anchor: أي : لا ينظرون ، فذكرهم ولا تلح عليهم ، ولا يهمنك أنهم لا ينظرون ولا يذكرون { إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكّرٌ } كقوله

MAWARDI:88:21/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet’s role is simply to preach.
MAWARDI:88:21/r1.anchor: فيه وجهان : أحدهما : إنما أنت واعظ

MAWARDI:88:21/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI:88:21/r2.claim: He is to remind them of blessings so that they fear punishments.

NASAFI:88:21/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:88:21/r1.claim: The Prophet should remind people with proofs so that they reflect on them.
NASAFI:88:21/r1.anchor: فذكرهم بالأدلة ليتفكروا فيها { إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكّرٌ }

NASAFI:88:21/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:88:21/r2.claim: The Prophet's duty is only to convey the message.
NASAFI:88:21/r2.anchor: { إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكّرٌ } ليس عليك إلا التبليغ

QURTUBI:88:21/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:88:21/r1.claim: Muḥammad is commanded to admonish and warn them.
QURTUBI:88:21/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى : " فذكر " أي فعظهم يا محمد وخوفهم

QURTUBI:88:21/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI:88:21/r2.claim: The Prophet is only an admonisher.

RAZI:88:21/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:88:21/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:88:21/r1.claim: After presenting proofs for monotheism and resurrection, God tells the Messenger to remind people with these and similar proofs, urging reflection and warning against neglect.

RAZI:88:21/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:88:21/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:88:21/r2.claim: The Messenger was sent for the work of reminding and must patiently endure whatever obstacles accompany it.
RAZI:88:21/r2.anchor: وذلك بعث منه تعالى للرسول على التذكير والصبر على كل عارض معه

JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p268/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p268/r2.speaker: author
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p268/r2.claim: Negation after إنما excludes a competing agent, while negation before it corrects which person acted; the verse gives the former pattern.
JURJANI-DALAIL:v1p268/r2.anchor: فمثال التأخير ما تراه في قولك : إنما يجيء زيد لا
